thread: sam (Design): quick run-through of the Create API key modal — trying to reduce CTA clutter and make the copy flow clearer. mock: https://imgur.com/mock1. Thoughts? jules (Frontend): agree we should minimize CTAs. Suggest primary = Copy, secondary = Download, tertiary = Done. Don't show 'Download' by default; show as overflow if small screen. lee (A11y): tabbable order must be Copy -> Download -> Done. focus should land on Copy. Add aria-describedby on the secret field: 'This secret will not be shown again.' marta (Product): support sees a lot of "I lost the key" tickets. ken, would a short re-open window help? ken (Support): yes — 45% of lost-key tickets were user-closed modals before copying. A 60s detachable drawer or a persistent snackbar link reduces tickets. sam (Design): proposal: modal shows secret + Copy button emphasized, small inline hint "You won't be able to view this again." add a tiny "Re-open for 60s" link in the toast after close. jules (Frontend): implement: focus copy button, set aria-live politely for the hint, assertive for copy success. Example: ```html You won't be able to view this again. ``` lee (A11y): don't auto-close for SR users. For toast's re-open link, make it keyboard-focusable and announce: "Secret available for 60 seconds." Ensure tooltip contrast >= 4.5:1. marta (Product): copy variants: A) "API key created. Copy now — you won't be able to see it again." B) "API key created. Copy now — this key can't be viewed later." Ken prefers B. sam (Design): I'll push mock with variant B and reduced CTA density by EOD. jules (Frontend): I'll branch feat/key-modal-tidy and add aria attributes + keyboard focus flow, ping @lee for review. deploy-bot: build queued for branch "feat/key-modal-tidy" — build 8010 started. :rocket: ken (Support): drafting KB: "How to copy your key after creation" with screenshot and re-open timing. lee (A11y): one last nit: icon buttons need aria-labels and visible focus outlines. Avoid color-only state indicators. sam (Design): thanks all — will share updated screenshot when ready. :thumbsup:
